department: Dave C. Swalm School of Chemical Engineering (Bagley College of Engineering)

deadline.value: The college review date for Fall is June 1.
deadline.quote: The application deadlines for all students are as follows: Fall Semester – June 1

gre_general.value: GRE scores are recommended but not required.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are recommended but not required.

toefl_min.value: Department minimum is TOEFL 550 paper-based (79 iBT) for all degrees.
toefl_min.quote: International students must have a TOEFL score of 550 PBT (79 iBT) or 6.5 on the IELTS for admission to all degree programs.

ielts_min.value: Department minimum is an IELTS score of 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: International students must have a TOEFL score of 550 PBT (79 iBT) or 6.5 on the IELTS for admission to all degree programs.

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by the graduate affairs committee, not by a named supervisor.
supervisor.quote: Admission decisions are made by the graduate affairs committee (GAC) based on the applicant’s academic transcripts, a personal essay (statement of purpose), research experience, letters of recommendation, and research interests.

entry_route.value: A direct PhD entry needs a 3.20 GPA on the last 64 hours; a post-master's PhD needs a 3.00 GPA.
entry_route.quote: Direct Admission to the Ph.D. Program | Post M.S. - Ph.D. Program

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

funding.value: Not stated on the official pages checked.

notes: Covers the Engineering PhD with Chemical Engineering concentration, run by the Swalm School. The college June 1 date applies. No graduate assistantship rule was stated beyond 'research assistantships are available'.
